messages.subject: Shadi | GCC Executive Profile | Regulatory, ESG, Corporate Affairs & Financial Services
messages.body:
Dear Mr. El Farr,

I am sharing my profile for senior GCC mandates across regulated industries, financial services, diversified groups and sovereign-linked environments.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My current remit covers government and regulatory relations, ESG, social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, compliance coordination and executive communications. Earlier in my career, I worked in regulated financial services, giving me useful cross-sector grounding for institutions where policy, regulation, reputation and stakeholder confidence intersect.

Your leadership of Heidrick & Struggles' Financial Services Practice across Asia Pacific and the Middle East, together with your work across banks, private capital, family groups and regional institutions, makes this a relevant introduction.

I am pursuing Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director and VP-track roles across Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG, External Affairs, Strategic Partnerships, Regulatory Strategy and related leadership functions. Saudi Arabia is my first GCC priority, followed by the UAE and wider region.

I have attached a GCC-focused executive CV. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
